architecture.system_overview: Tauri v2 multiplatform desktop and mobile ASCII-rendering application sealed in a sandbox architecture matching Docker-grade process isolation. Combines a high-performance WebGPU/WebGL/Canvas rendering frontend (React 19 + TypeScript + Vite) with a secure Rust backend core and isolated sidecar pipeline.

android.graphics: Vulkan-backed WebGPU with automatic WebGL2 / Canvas2D fallback
android.packaging: Signed Android Package (.apk) & Android App Bundle (.aab)

sandbox_isolation_model.security_posture: Docker-equivalent containerized boundary within Tauri v2 Runtime Authority
sandbox_isolation_model.content_security_policy: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: tauri:; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none';
sandbox_isolation_model.filesystem_containment: Scoped strictly to isolated $APP_DATA/ascii_workspace, $TEMP, and explicitly user-selected dialog paths. Path canonicalization and symlink breakout prevention enforced on all IPC file boundaries.

tier1_webgpu.engine: WebGPU Compute Shader + Glyph Texture Atlas
tier1_webgpu.performance: 60 FPS up to 4K resolution (sub-2ms GPU pass)
tier1_webgpu.mechanism: Source frame converted to luminance texture in GPU memory -> compute shader maps luminance to character atlas coordinates -> instanced glyph draw call

tier2_webgl.engine: WebGL2 Fragment Shader + Pre-rasterized Font Texture
tier2_webgl.mechanism: Hardware fragment shader sampling glyph grid lookup table with bilinear filtering disabled

tier3_canvas2d.mechanism: TypedArray Uint8ClampedArray luminance calculation with batched font glyph blitting

rust_sidecar.engine: Native Rust ascii-engine CLI / Dynamic Library
rust_sidecar.purpose: Headless batch conversion, raw disk image encoding, video frame demuxing, and deterministic regression testing

procedural_3d_engine.implementation: Raymarching and analytical 3D projection algorithms ported to TypeScript/WebGL shaders, preserving exact mathematical equations from Python core (torus revolution, Lambertian cosine shading, gravitational light deflection).

motion_lifecycle.entry: AnimatePresence mode=wait (single orchestrated character matrix cascade on load)
motion_lifecycle.unmount_cleanup: WebGL context lost handled, Canvas2D detached, Web Worker terminated, RAF cancelled, memory scrubbed

breaking_scenarios.name: Massive 8K Image Payload & Memory Exhaustion Attack
breaking_scenarios.vector: User uploads 8192x8192 uncompressed TIFF/PNG image (256MB+ in RAM) or scrubs 4K 60FPS video stream into the renderer.
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: Browser tab crash, out-of-memory WebGL allocation failure, or IPC serialization hang.
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Pre-flight dimension clamp in Web Worker before GPU upload. Automatically scales max dimensions to 2048x2048 with bilinear downsampling. Rust sidecar applies streaming chunks without loading full raw bitmap into IPC memory.
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Clamp buffer dimensions, stream chunks via OffscreenCanvas, emit warning banner if downsampling occurred.

breaking_scenarios.name: Graphics Context Loss & Android WebGPU Incompatibility Cascade
breaking_scenarios.vector: App launched on Android WebView lacking WebGPU support, or GPU context lost during device lock / backgrounding.
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: Silent black screen, unhandled JavaScript promise rejection, renderer halt.
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Automatic hierarchical fallback cascade: Tier 1 (WebGPU) -> Tier 2 (WebGL2) -> Tier 3 (Canvas 2D). Context lost event listener triggers immediate soft restart without unmounting UI state.
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Switch active render tier to Canvas2D, notify user with subtle status badge, resume animation loop.

breaking_scenarios.name: High-Frequency Slider Scrubbing IPC Backpressure & Frame Flooding
breaking_scenarios.vector: User or test script scrubs contrast/gamma sliders at 120Hz while real-time camera stream is actively converting frames.
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: IPC queue saturation, dropped UI thread frames, memory leak from buffered unrendered frames.
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Latest-frame-only synchronization with requestAnimationFrame gate. State updates pass through an atomic frame slot; obsolete pending renders are cancelled before IPC dispatch.
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Drop intermediate frames, render only current tick, maintain stable 60 FPS without memory buildup.

breaking_scenarios.name: Sandbox File Traversal & Unauthorized Sidecar Command Injection
breaking_scenarios.vector: Attacker attempts directory traversal (e.g. `../../../../etc/passwd` or `C:\Windows\System32`) via export path or IPC command injection.
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: Host filesystem escape, arbitrary binary execution.
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Tauri v2 ACL runtime authority rejects file operations outside permitted scopes. Rust backend canonicalizes all paths with `std::fs::canonicalize` and rejects non-whitelisted paths before OS dispatch.
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: IPC returns PermissionDenied error response, logs audit security event, does not execute disk I/O.

designer_lane.scope: Frontend UI layout, CSS token overrides (--radius: 6px, dark phosphor palette #00ff88 / #0a0a0f), responsive bento grid, 3D viewport canvas, ASCII text preview area, single orchestrated load reveal animation.
designer_lane.banned_actions: Writing bespoke ad-hoc CSS from scratch without design tokens, adding multi-stage blanket transitions, leaving unstyled shadcn defaults.

fixer_lane.scope: Tauri v2 configuration (`tauri.conf.json`, `capabilities/default.json`), Rust command handlers, 3-tier ASCII engine implementation (WebGPU shader, WebGL2 shader, Canvas 2D worker), 3D math ports, IPC contracts, Playwright test suite.
fixer_lane.banned_actions: Using `any` casts, tautological tests (`expect(true).toBe(true)`), unhandled catch blocks, bypassing Tauri ACL sandbox.
